'''Edwards''' is a male [[NPC]] found at [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy - Square]], praying at the fountain.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Edwards:''' [[Hsin]] the Moon Fox, [[Fang]] the Sun Hare, [[Promeus]]... Oh Sentinels above, I need your help...
:;'''Edwards:''' Any one of you, just let me pass, I'm begging you...

==Dialogue==
:'''Edwards:''' ...Does wishing like this even work? It's so statistically unsound... Ah, screw it!
:'''Edwards:''' Oh mysterious entity of the wishing fountain... whether you're a Sentinel, a human, a TD, or even an Exoswarm...
:'''Edwards:''' Under the law of equivalent exchange, I offer my most prized possession and make this wish...
:'''Edwards:''' Please, let probability be on my side and make my advisor overlook my buggy code so I can pass this exam!
----
:'''Trash Can:''' &%#A*...!!!
:'''Resigned Support Staff:''' Calm down, don't be upset. We'll find whoever started that ridiculous 'wishing fountain" rumor.
:'''Resigned Support Staff:''' But... why are they tossing things in there? The rumor was about exchanging VALUABLES, not junk!
:'''Resigned Support Staff:''' Coins, I understand. But textbooks?
:'''Resigned Support Staff:''' This one's from the Department of Light Energy Sciences. Even has a name on it. I'll call him to come get it...
{{Dialogue End}}
